# Litz wire research / Litz 线研究

> Agent-driven reviewable modeling and simulation, with bilingual research manuscripts and seven physical routes.
> 智能体驱动的可复核建模与仿真，包含双语研究稿件与七条物理路线。

### route/analytic — Round-wire analytical calibration / 单圆线解析校准

en: Change frequency/current; compare independent current and Joule integrals.

zh-CN: 修改频率与总电流，核对独立电流积分与焦耳积分。

- [models/analytic/README.md](models/analytic/README.md)
- [models/analytic/README.zh-CN.md](models/analytic/README.zh-CN.md)

### route/aphi — Preserved A–φ field diagnostics / 保存 A–φ 场诊断

en: Read actual saved fields and reproduce J, phi and gauge residuals. Original field parameters remain visible.

zh-CN: 读取实际保存场，复算 J、电势与规范残差，保留原场参数。

- [models/aphi/README.md](models/aphi/README.md)
- [models/aphi/README.zh-CN.md](models/aphi/README.zh-CN.md)

### route/common_terminal — Common-terminal current sharing / 共端复电流分配

en: Change strand count or return geometry; inspect complex strand currents and input/loss balance.

zh-CN: 修改股数或回流几何；检查复电流及输入功率与损耗。

- [models/common_terminal/README.md](models/common_terminal/README.md)
- [models/common_terminal/README.zh-CN.md](models/common_terminal/README.zh-CN.md)

### route/fem2 — Two-dimensional diffusion FEM / 二维扩散有限元

en: Change mesh_h; run at least three meshes before making a convergence claim.

zh-CN: 修改 mesh_h；收敛判断至少运行三档网格。

- [models/fem2/README.md](models/fem2/README.md)
- [models/fem2/README.zh-CN.md](models/fem2/README.zh-CN.md)

### route/geometry — Geometry and transposition / 几何与换位

en: Change topology, pitch or length; inspect gaps, arc lengths and copper volume. Geometry is a model input.

zh-CN: 修改结构、节距或长度；检查间隙、弧长与铜体积。几何是场模型的输入。

- [models/geometry/README.md](models/geometry/README.md)
- [models/geometry/README.zh-CN.md](models/geometry/README.zh-CN.md)

### route/peec — Finite-length longitudinal PEEC / 有限长度纵向 PEEC

en: Change length or cross divisions; compare complex port constraints and power. The basis is longitudinal.

zh-CN: 修改长度或横向离散，核对复端口约束与功率。基函数沿纵向。

- [models/peec/README.md](models/peec/README.md)
- [models/peec/README.zh-CN.md](models/peec/README.zh-CN.md)

### route/rt0 — Vector RT0 volume PEEC / 向量 RT0 体积 PEEC

en: Choose field or transport excitation. The field case has 1 mT RMS imposed Bz and zero net transport.

zh-CN: 选择外场或输运激励。外场算例为 1 mT RMS Bz、零净输运。

- [models/rt0/README.md](models/rt0/README.md)
- [models/rt0/README.zh-CN.md](models/rt0/README.zh-CN.md)

### workflow/compare-solvers — Compare matching field models / 比较一致的场模型

en: Align geometry, copper area, material, frequency, RMS/peak convention, axial length, terminal constraints, return and boundaries. Solve independently. Compare complex currents, power and Rac with discretization and geometry differences visible.

zh-CN: 对齐几何、铜面积、材料、频率、RMS/峰值、轴向长度、端口、回流和边界；独立求解后比较复电流、功率与 Rac，同时报告离散和几何差异。

- [automation/workflows/compare-solvers/README.md](automation/workflows/compare-solvers/README.md)
- [automation/workflows/compare-solvers/README.zh-CN.md](automation/workflows/compare-solvers/README.zh-CN.md)

### workflow/diagnose — Diagnose and recover a failed run / 诊断失败并恢复

en: Preserve the original failure and actual tool response. Separate transport, API, solver, resource and physical failures. Test the smallest relevant correction, record its rationale and code diff, rerun with a new identity, compare acceptance without weakening tolerances.

zh-CN: 保留原失败和工具响应，定位协议、API、求解、资源或物理问题；验证最小相关修正，记录依据与差异，使用新身份重跑并核对原验收条件。

- [automation/workflows/diagnose/README.md](automation/workflows/diagnose/README.md)
- [automation/workflows/diagnose/README.zh-CN.md](automation/workflows/diagnose/README.zh-CN.md)

### workflow/extend-model — Extend a model with verification / 扩展模型并验证

en: State the new capability and unchanged scientific conventions. Read the equations and implementation. Save a focused code change, add independent physical/regression checks, run original and new cases, explain scope and unresolved uncertainty.

zh-CN: 说明新增能力与物理条件，阅读方程和实现；保存代码差异，增加独立物理及回归检查，运行原案例与新案例，解释适用范围与不确定性。

- [automation/workflows/extend-model/README.md](automation/workflows/extend-model/README.md)
- [automation/workflows/extend-model/README.zh-CN.md](automation/workflows/extend-model/README.zh-CN.md)

### workflow/report — Build evidence-backed research output / 构建有证据支持的研究成果

en: Use explicit accepted or diagnostic run identities. Read results and assumptions, preserve units and complex quantities, generate traceable figures, cite the canonical library, build and visually inspect the requested documents.

zh-CN: 选用明确的验收或诊断运行身份，核对结果、假设、单位和复数；生成可追溯图件，引用统一题录，构建并实际阅读所需文档。

- [automation/workflows/report/README.md](automation/workflows/report/README.md)
- [automation/workflows/report/README.zh-CN.md](automation/workflows/report/README.zh-CN.md)

### workflow/reproduce — Reproduce a recorded model / 复现已有模型

en: Select a model, explicit case and evidence dataset. Verify source identity and physical assumptions. Run doctor and dry-run, execute into a new run, inspect checks and compare only matching observables.

zh-CN: 选择模型、案例和证据数据集，核对来源与假设；完成环境检查和预检后使用新运行号执行，解释验收并比较一致的观测量。

- [automation/workflows/reproduce/README.md](automation/workflows/reproduce/README.md)
- [automation/workflows/reproduce/README.zh-CN.md](automation/workflows/reproduce/README.zh-CN.md)
